title: Exploring Multi-Lingual Bias of Large Code Models in Code Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Pass@1 code generation performance of large code models when prompted with semantically equivalent instructions in English versus Chinese using the custom X-HumanEval-X benchmark.
Evaluating and comparing the discrepancy in Pass@1 code generation success rates across different programming languages (Python, C++, and Java) using the X-HumanEval-X benchmark.
